title: Zone List Not Displaying on Dashboard After Site Switch
description: The Zone List on the Dashboard fails to display after switching from a DX site to a previous site.
steps: Observe that the Zone List is visible.
Switch back to the previous site.
actual: After switching back to the previous site, the Zone List is no longer displayed on the Dashboard.
expected: The Zone List should remain visible on the Dashboard after switching back to the previous site.
